title.en: WHITE SOX vs. BLUE JAYS: Official Highlights (July 19) | 2026 MLB Season
title.ja: ホワイトソックスが3-0の完封勝利、ブルージェイズは無援護で今日も敗戦【海外の反応】

summaryJa: ホワイトソックスが先発イェサベージと継投で3-0の完封勝利（JST7月20日）。村上宗隆は3打数無安打（1四球2三振）と沈黙もチームは52勝46敗でAL中地区首位を維持。ブルージェイズファンからは「ヤサベージが好投しても打線が援護ゼロ」「ゲレーロJrはいつ本気出すの」という嘆きが殺到。「ソックスに乗り換えれば楽しいよ」という煽りコメントも飛び出した。岡本和真・ミゲル・バルガスも揃って沈黙し、ブルージェイズ打線の深刻な不振が際立った。

media.videoTitle: WHITE SOX vs. BLUE JAYS: Official Full Game Highlights (July 19) | 2026 MLB Season

comments.author: @Goleafsgo101
comments.bodyEn: It's getting really hard watching this team now it really is, I use to be so excited to watch the jays now it's just sad
comments.bodyJa: このチームを見るのがつらくなってきた。昔はジェイズ戦が楽しみだったのに、今はただ悲しい

comments.author: @WillR-p5p
comments.bodyEn: Tough for some of the Jays pitchers, they're hurling decent games but getting next to no run support.
comments.bodyJa: ジェイズの投手陣が可哀想。まともな投球をしても援護がほぼゼロ

comments.author: @shakiemjeanjoseph428
comments.bodyEn: The Chicago White Sox are 52-46⚫️⚪️⚾️🧦
comments.bodyJa: シカゴ・ホワイトソックス 52勝46敗⚫️⚪️

comments.author: @jonpalmer5251
comments.bodyEn: back to back games of both teams pitchers just dealing.
comments.bodyJa: 両チームの投手陣が2試合連続でディーリング中

comments.author: @Raziel_HHL
comments.bodyEn: after watching this I really cannot understand how we managed to win yesterdays game tbh
comments.bodyJa: これを見たら昨日どうやって勝ったのか本当にわからない

comments.author: @michaelmarkowski204
comments.bodyEn: Someone tell Vladdy the regular season has started.
comments.bodyJa: ゲレーロJrにレギュラーシーズンが始まったと誰か教えてあげて

comments.author: @zachsmith8967
comments.bodyEn: Vladdy LOVES to hit grounders into short stop even when there isn't a chance for a Double play he tries to give them one
comments.bodyJa: ゲレーロJrはショートへのゴロが大好き。ゲッツーの場面じゃなくてもわざわざゲッツーを作ろうとする

comments.author: @YSZ-n8l
comments.bodyEn: Blue Jays have been carried by Okamoto and Seise in the first half, but when Okamoto doesn't hit, there's absolutely no sense of scoring from the lineup. This team is completely dependent on Okamoto. Do something about Guerrero, who's been in a slump forever.
comments.bodyJa: ブルージェイズは前半戦岡本とシースに支えられてた感あるけど打撃陣は岡本が打てない日は全く得点の雰囲気ない。完全に岡本次第のチーム。ずーっと低調なゲレーロなんとかしてくれ

comments.author: @calronske1853
comments.bodyEn: The White Sox starters have been solid, bullpen great at times, overall solid. Lineup is full of "real" baseball players. Everyone contributes, different guys every night.
comments.bodyJa: ホワイトソックスの先発は安定し、ブルペンも上々。打線は「本物の野球選手」だらけ。毎晩違う選手が活躍する

comments.author: @calronske1853
comments.bodyEn: Switch to the White Sox. Then you'll be happy.
comments.bodyJa: ホワイトソックスに乗り換えれば楽しくなるよ

comments.author: @bchu2879
comments.bodyEn: vladdy's contract starting to look like highway robbery atp...
comments.bodyJa: ゲレーロJrの契約、もはや詐欺レベルに見えてきた

comments.author: @Hellwolf36
comments.bodyEn: Both pitchers brought their A game. Just one pitcher didn't go and maintain himself longer. I might be a Jays fan, but I acknowledge and respect the work the White Sox have done going through abysmal seasons to getting back into relevance again.
comments.bodyJa: 両投手とも本気を出した。ジェイズファンだけど、最悪の時代を乗り越えてここまで戻ってきたソックスは素直に認めて尊敬する

comments.author: @KnowYourDram
comments.bodyEn: When was the last time Yesavage got ANY run support during his start?? So glad we're paying 10s of millions to Vlad for singles and ground outs. 🤦‍♂️
comments.bodyJa: イェサベージが援護をもらったのはいつが最後？数千万ドルを払ってゲレーロに単打とゴロを打ってもらってる😤

comments.author: @bigboy0625
comments.bodyEn: The season over for the Jays now. Gone from 2nd best team to the worst. Sad 😢
comments.bodyJa: ジェイズのシーズンはもう終わった。2番目の強豪から最悪のチームへ転落。悲しい😢

comments.author: @R58-n8n
comments.bodyEn: It's time to throw in the towel. The Jays are sellers at the end of July.
comments.bodyJa: もう諦める時。ジェイズは7月末のトレードで売り手に回るべき

comments.author: @NvidiaPalantirAmd
comments.bodyEn: Love the sox
comments.bodyJa: ソックス最高

comments.author: @shopretroreplay
comments.bodyEn: At this point just tell the guys to swing for the fences every at bat. Strategic anything is not working. Being patient is not working.
comments.bodyJa: もうフルスイング一択にしたら。どんな作戦も、我慢の野球も機能してない

comments.author: @shazbaggle8268
comments.bodyEn: If we can just get Murakami going again, i think this offense could ascend to one of the best in the league with Murakami and Colton on either side of Vargas.
comments.bodyJa: 村上が復調すれば、ムラカミ－バルガス－コルトンの並びで打線はリーグ最強クラスになれる

comments.author: @squidca2455
comments.bodyEn: I love John Schneider as a person, but he makes John Gibbons look like a genius. It's actually incredible that he's dragging this roster to THIRD LAST IN THE AL.
comments.bodyJa: シュナイダー監督は人間としては好きだが、ギボンズを天才に見せてしまってる。このロスターをAL下から3位に引きずり下ろすのはある意味才能

comments.author: @BrittanyBehenna
comments.bodyEn: I was at my first blue Jay's game and got my hat signed by Valensaula
comments.bodyJa: 初めてジェイズ戦を生観戦し、バレンズエラにサインしてもらえた

comments.author: @miscellaneousstuff2901
comments.bodyEn: Jays bats are way too impatient. Going after so many first pitches, chasing balls. They need to make the opposing pitchers work for it.
comments.bodyJa: ジェイズ打線は焦りすぎ。初球打ちやボール球を追いすぎ。相手投手に球数を投げさせる忍耐が必要

comments.author: @Red_Sector_7
comments.bodyEn: This is exactly why you do not sign players to extreme long term contracts like 10-15 year deals. There is zero possibility the Jays make the post-season.
comments.bodyJa: だから10〜15年の超長期契約をしてはいけない。ジェイズのポスシーズン進出はゼロ

comments.author: @markcharron9748
comments.bodyEn: Changes definitely need to be made with these Jays. The talent they could have got for just trading Guerrero and the money they could have spent on free agents.
comments.bodyJa: 絶対に変革が必要。ゲレーロをトレードして得られた戦力と、そのお金で取れたFAを想像すると悔しい

comments.author: @SlaveKing

comments.bodyEn: 9th inning says it all about how the season has gone for the Jays. Clement and Lukes get on base with infield singles with no outs then Vlad Jr flys out and Okamoto grounds into a doubleplay.
